name: Faizan Abbas
successStory:
"When I graduated from COMSATS University with a degree in Software Engineering, I knew one thing — the real challenge was about to begin. The job market was tough, and competition was everywhere. Still, I promised myself that I wouldn’t settle for “average.”

For the first few weeks after graduation, I treated job hunting like a full-time job itself. I rebuilt my resume three times, refined my LinkedIn profile until it looked like a startup pitch, and spent nights learning the latest tools and frameworks that companies were actually using. I also faced plenty of rejection emails (and some no replies at all), but I took each one as free feedback instead of failure.

Then, in less than two months, things turned around — I landed a position worth over 200K PKR per month. It wasn’t luck; it was consistency. The interview wasn’t easy, but thanks to the solid foundation I built at COMSATS and the extra hours I invested in upskilling, I was ready for it.

If there’s one thing I learned from this journey, it’s that success doesn’t come from waiting — it comes from showing up every day, even when it’s uncomfortable.

A little caffeine, a lot of effort, and a belief that “maybe tomorrow is the day” — that’s how I got here."
